entry.title: New: Resolution 721 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO ALA KAHAKAI TRAIL ASSOCIATION

Approves a grant of $80,000 to Ala Kahakai Trail Association, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to develop a community resource management plan for the Kaunāmano, Ka‘ū, property (Tax Map Keys: 9-5-011:001, 004, 005, 006, and 9-5-012:001), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.
